description: Brand icons for the application catalogue, keyed by winget package identifier. Each path is a single SVG outline on a 24 by 24 canvas, drawn in one colour so it reads correctly on both themes. Applications with no entry here fall back to the icon for their category, which is why this file is allowed to be incomplete.
source: Simple Icons 13.21.0, https://simpleicons.org, released under CC0 1.0.
